prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 8 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1440; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism and force of the impact. Over the course of eight visits, care consisted of conservative management including soft tissue treatment, range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Examination revealed muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, supporting the diagnosis of cervical strain, while neurological screening and reflex testing remained within normal limits. No prior injury to the cervical region is known to the provider or reported by the patient. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and pain levels declined. Billing records reflect one charge per scheduled service, with no duplicate or repeated billing entries. The patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur or worsen.
